allOf.description:
Base envelope delivered to merchant webhook endpoints. Every webhook
request body has the shape `{ id, event, category, data }`; concrete
event schemas compose this base via `allOf` and refine `event` /
`category` to their `const` values and `data` to a specific schema.

Each delivery carries three headers:
  CrowdSplit-Signature        `t={unix-ts},v1={hex-hmac-sha256}`
  CrowdSplit-Timestamp        seconds since epoch
  CrowdSplit-Notification-Id  unique per delivery (idempotency)

Merchants MUST verify the HMAC of the raw body using the webhook
secret returned at registration, and SHOULD reject the delivery if
`CrowdSplit-Timestamp` differs from the current time by more than
5 minutes. Duplicate `CrowdSplit-Notification-Id` values indicate a
retry of a previously dispatched delivery and should be deduplicated.

id.description: Unique notification ID (stable across retry attempts).

event.description: Event name; specialized via `allOf` per operation (e.g. `payment.succeeded`).

category.description: Event category; specialized via `allOf` per operation (e.g. `payment_lifecycle`).

data.description: Event-specific payload; each operation refines this via `allOf` to a concrete schema.

allOf.title: WebhookEnvelope

data.description: Data payload for customer sync events

provider.description:
CrowdSplit-managed upstream provider identifier. Lowercased in every
merchant-facing payload; the internal enum keys are defined in `util/enum/PLATFORMS.js`.

Note: merchant-facing `*.provider` fields receive a special
transform (`util/helper.js:314-326`) that emits `avenia` in place
of `brla` in the lowercased form; consumers should treat the two
as equivalent for now.
provider.title: ProviderName

synced_at.description: Timestamp of successful sync (only on success)

provider_data.description:
Data returned from the provider (only on success). Shape varies
by provider — do not rely on specific keys.

data.title: WebhookCustomerSyncData
